description: This file contains functions for managing multi-selection actions such as moving notes, notebooks, attachments, reminders, and tags to trash, restoring from trash, and permanently deleting items within the Notesnook project. It includes interactions with various stores, dialogs, and task management utilities.

methods.name: moveNotesToTrash
methods.description: Moves specified notes to trash, with optional confirmation and vault unlocking.

methods.name: moveNotebooksToTrash
methods.description: Moves specified notebooks to trash, with confirmation dialog.

methods.name: deleteAttachments
methods.description: Permanently deletes specified attachments after confirmation.

methods.name: moveRemindersToTrash
methods.description: Moves specified reminders to trash with confirmation.

methods.name: deleteTags
methods.description: Deletes specified tags and refreshes related stores.

methods.name: restoreItemsFromTrash
methods.description: Restores items from trash, checking feature availability.

methods.name: deleteItemsFromTrash
methods.description: Permanently deletes items from trash after confirmation.
